title: Output after dropping an input prefix
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $i$, apply the transducer that emits one zero on each bit after it has read a zero, and emits nothing before then, to the suffix obtained by dropping the first $i$ bits of the string consisting of $m-1$ ones, then a zero, then $m$ ones. The output is a string of $m$ zeros if $i<m$, and is empty if $i\ge m$.
